# Caveman Help

Show this quick card only. Do not change mode automatically.

- `/caveman` -> full
- `/caveman lite`
- `/caveman ultra`
- `stop caveman` or `normal mode` -> disable

Rule summary:
- terse language
- technical accuracy intact
- code and literals unchanged
